notes.title: Announcing the next game from the devs of TENDY: Robot Gardener!
notes.notes:
Hey, this is Michael! One of the devs of TENDY. In the year since release, I've been hard at work on a new title: FORKLIFT FLOWERPOT! It's got even more of that weird and wiggly artstyle, and dips its toes into a lot of different genres: Exploration! Puzzles! Deckbuilding?

We are [b]launching the demo this week[/b] as a part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073330/FORKLIFT_FLOWERPOT/
Check out the Steam page and give it a [b]Wishlist[/b]!


I can't wait for yall to try it out.
<3 Michael

notes.title: Puzzle game collection CosmOS 9 is a gentle introduction to the genre
notes.notes:
A new collection of indie puzzle games released today aims to give a broad and gentle introduction to many puzzling subgenres. Wrapped up in that idea that they're all pulled from a mysterious alien games console, CosmOS 9 packs nine games that are each meant to take 30-90 minutes. I've played a few and they seemed puzzle game staples, having me drawing paths through blocks, figure out how a mysterious computer interface worked, and such. See the breadth of the cosmic puzzling experience in the trailer below.
